source: Yahoo Finance chart daily close (adjusted for ETF if available)
classification: EXPLORATORY only: previously examined history is reused; NO unbiased fresh holdout

models.volatility: Daily-close HAR-style log realized-volatility ridge; no intraday realized-vol data
models.regime: Close>SMA200 and 20-bar volatility above trailing median of 252 observed values
models.macro: Lagged previous-calendar-day-only VIX, US10Y, DXY/UUP, oil/USO, SPX
models.fairness: Macro and own-price logistic/regression model on exact same available sample dates, expanding walk-forward, 252 matured observations, refit 21 bars
models.horizon: 5,10,20 native daily bars; indices use trading days; crypto includes weekends
models.caveat: Overlapping labels, no execution or trading costs; avoid treating small historical gains as validated alpha
